title: Saudi pilots filmed orbs
summary: Jesse Michels tells of Saudi pilots filmed orbs, about 2024 at Saudi Arabia, and frames it as the host. As told, not a fact.

tellings.quote: I think if what was it last week two pilots in Saudi Arabia are flying and and they saw some crazy orb action

plain: A podcast host, Jesse Michels, says that in 2024 two pilots flying over Saudi Arabia saw, and filmed, what he calls some crazy orb action: glowing round objects in the sky. He brings it up as a sign that pilots around the world keep running into things they can't explain.
